summary: Meiwu Technology Co Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of the disposition of its wholly owned BVI subsidiary, Mahaotiaodong Information Technology Company, to unrelated third party Li Dong for $100. The Equity Transfer Agreement was entered on 1 July 2026 and closed on 9 July 2026. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor was named. The transaction is a simple all-cash sale of 100% of shares. Going forward, the minimal consideration may indicate a deconsolidation or asset-light strategy; watch for any subsequent related-party or regulatory filings.
